description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three different models or configurations across three evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis displays the categorical metrics, ordered from left to right as "Recall", a middle category whose label is obscured by a solid grey rectangle, and "F1 Score". The vertical axis represents the corresponding numerical values on a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 100 with tick marks at regular intervals of 20, though it lacks an explicit axis title. The chart utilizes grouped vertical bars, where each of the three metric categories contains a cluster of three bars. A legend at the top indicates that light blue bars represent "DIN-SQL (zero-shot)", dark blue bars represent "TA-SQL (zero-shot)", and light green bars represent "DIN-SQL (few-shot)". Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation above it. In the "Recall" group, the values are 63.58 for light blue (the shortest bar in the chart), 71.90 for dark blue, and 72.29 for light green. For the obscured middle category, the bars measure 88.89 (light blue), 91.24 (dark blue), and 92.31 (light green, which is the tallest bar overall). In the "F1 Score" group, the values are 75.34 (light blue), 80.40 (dark blue), and 81.08 (light green). Within each group, the bars are consistently arranged from left to right following the order of the legend, with no specific sorting applied to the overarching categories.
